rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The party journal reports that 'On October 27th 2004, at the spacious Talkatora Stadium, New Delhi', 'Shri Lal Kishanchand Advani's election as Bharatiya Janata Party's National President was unanimously endorsed by BJP's supreme body - The National Council', on a resolution put by Shri Venkaiah Naidu that the Council passed unanimously.

locator.section: first paragraph; paragraph ending 'the National Council unanimously passed this resolution'

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The same report says Shri Jaswant Singh 'praised the outgoing President Shri Venkaiah Naidu' and that 'Shri Venkaiah Naidu gave his farewell speech' before putting the endorsing resolution.

rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The same report says Atalji called Advani's appointment as party President a historic day and said 'this was the 5th time that Advaniji was being appointed the President'.

locator.section: paragraph beginning 'Atalji called the appointment of Advaniji'
